issue: Linux native Desktop strict set_value reports every native pre-send refusal as PERMISSION_DENIED

production_reproduction.target: Address and search bar in a test-owned New Tab
production_reproduction.readback: fresh complete tree after the refused write; no replacement text appeared

same_worker_native_diagnostic.scope: same isolated native diagnostic worker; not the previous production worker

cause.native: Chrome reports an editable entry but does not implement AT-SPI EditableText. GetInterfaces succeeds; proxies.editable_text() refuses before SetTextContents.
cause.provider: ax_write::invoke discarded every validated pre-send refusal code and replaced its cause with PermissionDenied.
cause.not_observed: The production worker permission snapshot and raw refusal were not exported by 0.8.0; the isolated diagnostic is not an in-memory observation of that worker.

authorization_availability.linux_source: Same authenticated worker check_permissions.atspi; fresh true means Granted/Available. Missing, false or expired means Unknown/Unavailable. xsend_event is not the DesktopAccessibility permission.

admission_audit.bindings: Strict setter install/prepare/validate_dispatch and recheck_write retain owner, resource, session, source, target, observation generation, age and native token checks. The explicit typing follow-up reuses these gates and additionally requires DesktopKeyboard and DesktopWindowsControl with DesktopAccessibility.

patch.scope: Original strict-setter classification patch at 78ad8c7: provider refusal classification and bounded native_refusal diagnostic only. The separately recorded explicit type_text follow-up below adds the normal public/Host/native typing route; strict setter behavior and owner checks remain intact.
patch.native_reason_visibility: Retained in Host receipt/wire and opt-in diagnostic. Existing Gateway not_dispatched projection preserves category but does not expose native_reason.
patch.unknown_writes: Remain terminal Unknown; no replay or input fallback was added.

validation.coverage: All seven native refusal codes; one strict RPC, zero effect on refusal, accurate cause/category/native_reason, unchanged gate refusal and unknown/no-replay tests.

The legacy wayland_keyboard result could not create a typed execution record. One earlier case delivered text and then correctly became unknown; it was not replayed. The final route records LinuxHyprlandForegroundInput only after the native writer completes.
